readout_other: open-field locomotor activity; modified Bederson neurological deficit score; rotarod; H&E; TTC; immunohistochemistry (FNDC5, BDNF, 8-OHdG); Western blot; TUNEL
direction_notes: LIPUS preconditioning plus post-stroke LIPUS, alone or with aerobic exercise, improved neurological and rotarod outcomes and histopathology in MCAO mice and raised FNDC5 and BDNF; neuronal excitability was not assessed.

exposures.label: LIPUS 1 MHz to lateral motor cortex, pre- and post-MCAO

timing.protocol_description: 20 min per day for three consecutive days before MCAO, then daily for 14 days starting on postoperative day 3; non-focused collimated beam, ERA 1 cm2; output power 50%.

source_quotes.n_subjects: divided into 7 groups (sham, sham + LIPUS, sham + exercise, MCAO, MCAO + LIPUS, MCAO + exercise, and MCAO + LIPUS + exercise; 9 mice/group)
